task: Expose exported object method signatures from canonical ABI-v10 records without relying on legacy semantic rows.
observation: The ABI-v10 nominal-template writer discarded the entire exported object template when one method had a non-no-op body, even when that method was a pure constant return whose callable signature and zero observable effects were straightforward to prove.
impact: Restricted pure primitive-literal return methods now retain nominal and method-template records. Closed Int, Bool, Float, and String results are covered, including a method with a typed READ parameter; a consumer with legacy object semantic rows removed loads all five signatures and type-checks the calls.

resolution.summary: Pure primitive-literal method signatures with closed READ parameters are serialized and consumed without legacy semantic rows; all eleven Java tests pass in staged ABI-v10 and ABI-v9. General method bodies, effect summaries, generic methods, and native linkage remain incomplete.
